A 6039-cograph finite census and 362227 parameter-set checks corroborate the all-size proof.

value.rationale: Sharp neighborhood complexity is a standard structural and finite-model quantity, relevant to how many distinct parameter-adjacency profiles can occur. The result improves the available d=0 general bound 4m to the optimal coefficient 2m, classifies all feasible counts 1..2m, and identifies the minimal 2m-vertex extremal witness, uniformly for all m. These are motivated nontrivial exact invariants, not arbitrary small enumerations.
